data.one_liner: Access and manage private data stores on Solid servers.
data.what_it_does: Solidpod provides the core business logic for Dart applications to authenticate users against Solid servers, read and write files in personal online data stores (PODs), and manage permissions.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application that interacts with Solid data vaults and servers.
You need user authentication via Solid-OIDC along with encrypted file storage within a POD.
avoid_when: Your application relies on centralized backends like Firebase or Supabase instead of decentralized Solid servers.
strengths: Supports secure authentication using Solid-OIDC protocol.
Provides file read, write, and deletion capabilities for data pods including large files.
Handles silent session restore on app startup.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration for Android, macOS, and web.
Dependent on external Solid server uptime and specification standards.
data.setup_notes: Requires client ID documents, OIDC redirect HTML files for web, intent queries and backup rules for Android, and keychain entitlements for macOS.
